en: The image shows a black-and-white (or sepia-toned) photograph of a large building complex with a tall church tower and spire, topped by a cross. The building, surrounded by trees and nestled on a hill, appears to be a religious or monastic structure. The foreground is a field, and the setting is rural. Printed text at the top left reads 'TAINACH, Kärnten' and at the top right 'Propstei'.
